policy: Do discovery and candidate selection using YouTube metadata/channel-age/view counts but do not infer video contents from it.
Watch the whole moving video and original audio from start to finish for EACH video selected for deep competitor study, not just the headliner or viral videos.
Store exact original video ID, title, source URI, duration, checksum, local authorized media proof, full audio+visual decode, and timecoded visual+audio observations at <=30s intervals.
Capture causal story structure, characters, timing, obstacles, acting/camera/props/world, voice, SFX/music, retention hypotheses as hypotheses, and full video conclusion.
Check both viral and underperforming controls; compare full episodes only after their own full reviews.
Separate OBSERVED pixels/sound from INFERRED production workflow and VERIFIED explicit official tool attribution.
Have an independent reviewer audit full source and scene notes. Missing audio or window means full-video gate blocked.
Only after full-watch gate passes may Script Room, Production Design, Character+Acting, Technical Director, Audio+Editorial and QC promote a competitor-based production method.
A 10-second local rendering sample is only a tech pilot AFTER source-video study, never a substitute for watching an entire competitor episode.
Studio may not pay to acquire transcripts, scrape licensed media, copy proprietary videos/assets or release without explicit owner rights and QC approval.
